turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must warn you, gentlemen, the matter I bring before you is of the utmost delicacy.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: State your case, Count Von Kramm, and let us proceed with all due haste.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear for the future of my kingdom, gentlemen, and I beg of you to help me in this matter.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Please, Your Majesty, tell us exactly what is troubling you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: My kingdom's future hangs in the balance, and I fear a scandal that may compromise the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: And you believe this scandal is connected to the person who employed me?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Yes, I fear that they may be involved, and that you, Mr. Holmes, may be the only one who can help me.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I am, in fact, aware of the true identity of the person who employed me, Count Von Kramm.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: But, Holmes, how do you know this?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Elementary, Watson, and I shall explain it all in due course.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must admit, gentlemen, I am both astonished and relieved that you are aware of the situation.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Now, let us proceed, Count Von Kramm, and hear the details of this matter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Very well, gentlemen, I shall tell you everything.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Please, Your Majesty, tell us the truth about the House of Ormstein.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: It is a long and complicated story, but I shall try to summarize it for you.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I think I see the threads of this case beginning to unravel, Count Von Kramm.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: You are a very perceptive man, Mr. Holmes, and I fear that you may be the only one who can help me now.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: But, Holmes, what exactly do you plan to do?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Leave that to me, Watson, and do not worry, Count Von Kramm, you are in good hands.
